description: Analyze an HTTP response from authorized probing for information leakage, fingerprinting signals, and related exposure. Structured findings cover version disclosures, stack traces, debug headers, internal paths, authentication patterns, CORS configuration, detection signals, remediation, and associated methodology vectors.

context.description: Freeform context about the authorized test target — e.g., "login endpoint", "GraphQL API", "file upload handler". Narrows the pattern matching to relevant categories. Max 2,000 characters.

response_body.description: Raw HTML, JSON, XML, or error response body text. Maximum 10,000 characters.

response_headers.description: Raw HTTP response headers, optionally including the status line. Maximum 20,000 characters.

status_code.description: HTTP status code (100–599). Helps classify the response type.

name: pentest_analyze_response

authorized_use_reminder.description: Reminder that response analysis is for authorized testing only. Rendered first.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_input`: Neither response_headers nor response_body was provided. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

findings.description: Structured findings ordered by severity descending (high first).

items.description: A single leakage or fingerprinting finding.

category.description: Finding category. version_disclosure = server/app version exposed; stack_trace = exception stacktrace leaked; internal_path = filesystem/internal route visible; debug_header = diagnostic header present; technology_fingerprint = framework/language signal; auth_pattern = JWT/cookie/auth mechanism visible; cors_misconfiguration = permissive CORS policy; security_header_missing = CSP/X-Frame-Options absent; interesting_field = non-obvious field worth noting; error_message = application/database error text.

detection.description: Observable signals associated with exploitation of this finding.

finding.description: What was detected and where — header name, body excerpt, or field path with surrounding context.

remediation.description: Recommended fix for the target application.

severity.description: Relative impact in an authorized testing context. info = fingerprinting only; low = indirect exposure; medium = useful for chaining; high = directly exploitable.

significance.description: Why this finding matters for an authorized penetration test.

suggested_vector.description: Pentest_get_guide vector name for follow-up when this finding maps to an attack vector. Absent when no direct vector mapping exists.

fingerprints.description: Detected server, framework, language, database, cloud, and other technology signals.

nextToolSuggestions.description: Suggested tools derived from detected fingerprints and findings.

items.description: A suggested tool with arguments derived from the analysis.

args.description: Arguments derived from detected fingerprints and findings.

reason.description: Relationship between the analysis findings and the suggested tool.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of findings and associated follow-up actions.

title: Pentest Analyze Response
